name: Molecular Dynamics & Monte Carlo Simulation
summary: Covers atomistic simulation of materials with molecular dynamics and Monte Carlo methods, from interatomic potentials to machine-learned force fields.

topics.name: Statistical mechanics refresher: ensembles and ergodicity
Interatomic potentials: pair potentials, EAM, Tersoff, ReaxFF and force fields for polymers
Integrating equations of motion: Verlet algorithms and time steps
Thermostats, barostats and periodic boundary conditions
Computing properties: diffusion coefficients, RDF, elastic constants and thermal conductivity
Simulating defects, dislocations, fracture and phase transitions
Metropolis Monte Carlo and cluster expansions
Kinetic Monte Carlo for diffusion and growth
Practical simulation with LAMMPS and analysis with OVITO
